title: Spread density of an open into every geometric fibre
statement: Let f:X→T be a finite type scheme morphism, η a generic point of T, and W an open subscheme of X. Suppose both X_η and W_η are geometrically irreducible. There is an open U containing η such that for every t in U and every field K with Spec K→Spec κ(t), the canonical inclusion W_t×κ(t)Spec K→X_t×κ(t)Spec K has dense range. Geometric irreducibility includes nonemptiness.

source.place: Tag 054X (Lemma 37.24.3), its use in Tag 0559, second proof; Tag 0383.

proof.text: Geometric irreducibility over the residue field gives irreducibility of X_eta and nonemptiness of W_eta. Its canonical map to X_eta is an open immersion, hence has dense range by Mathlib IsOpenMap.denseRange_of_isPreirreducibleSpace. Scheme.Pullback.range_map identifies that range with the inverse image of W under the fibre inclusion.
Apply exists_open_fibre_dense_of_generic_dense to obtain an open U containing eta on which the inverse image of W is dense in each ordinary fibre.

For every field extension z, the projection from the geometric fibre to the ordinary fibre is open: Mathlib supplies UniversallyOpen for a morphism with integral subsingleton target, and this property is stable under base change. Dense.preimage preserves density along this projection. Scheme.Pullback.range_map identifies this dense inverse image with the range of the double pullback map in the statement, since the other comparison map is the identity. This proves the full geometric-fibre conclusion. Surjectivity of the projection is unnecessary.

proof_origin.place: Tag 054X ordinary-density step isolated; generic density and arbitrary field-extension glue proved using Mathlib Topology.Irreducible, Dense.preimage, Scheme.Pullback.range_map and UniversallyOpen.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_open_geometric_fibre_dense_of_open {X T : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ T) [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (W : X.Opens) (η : T) (hη : IsGenericPoint η Set.univ)
    (hgeom : GeometricallyIrreducible (f.fiberToSpecResidueField η))
    (hWgeom : GeometricallyIrreducible ((W.ι ≫ f).fiberToSpecResidueField η)) :
    ∃ U : T.Opens, η ∈ U ∧
      ∀ (t : T), t ∈ U → ∀ (K : Type u) [Field K]
        (z : Spec (.of K) ⟶ Spec (T.residueField t)),
        DenseRange (pullback.map ((W.ι ≫ f).fiberToSpecResidueField t) z
          (f.fiberToSpecResidueField t) z
          (pullback.map (W.ι ≫ f) (T.fromSpecResidueField t) f
            (T.fromSpecResidueField t) W.ι (𝟙 _) (𝟙 _) (by simp) (by simp))
          (𝟙 _) (𝟙 _) (by simp [Scheme.Hom.fiberToSpecResidueField]) (by simp))
